brief: The canvas displays a vast, simulated open-world cityscape environment rendered in three dimensions. The viewer experiences a navigable space of buildings and detailed ground surfaces. The core visual elements include varying pavement textures, architectural structures, and a dynamically shifting time of day. These elements interact to create realistic shadows that are projected onto the ground. These shadows are not static; they dynamically interact with the pavement textures, causing the visible ground surface to reveal detailed signs of differential grime and weathering, simulating real-world environmental wear as the player navigates the scene.

statement: This sketch creates a dynamic, three-dimensional cityscape using p5.js's WEBGL renderer. The scene features randomly generated buildings of varying sizes and heights, arranged in a grid-like pattern across the canvas. A time-of-day cycle continuously shifts the position of a light source, casting moving shadows that interact with the ground surface. The environment includes a textured ground plane with subtle variations in color and shape to simulate real-world pavement details. The entire scene evolves autonomously without any user input, demonstrating both the visual complexity and fluid motion possible within the constraints of the p5.js framework.
